review_notes: The file is a single theorem, so I read all of it. I also read the definition of cubicThetaOmegaUnit and searched the CubicMoment directory for its uses. I checked the lemmas the proof rewrites with (cubicThetaArithmeticFourierResidue_neg, cubicThetaArithmeticFourierResidue_primary_unit, cubicThetaOmegaUnit_inverse_value). I did not recommend simp attributes on those residue lemmas: they carry hypotheses (h ≠ 0, primary h) and the rewrites are targeted. I did not run Lean, so the replacement is untested. The new simp lemma should be safe: it is a left-to-right rewrite of a coercion of a fixed constant, so I see no loop, and it is `rfl` in the same way as the existing cubicThetaOmegaUnit_inverse_value.

findings.problem: cubicThetaOmegaUnit has no simp or coercion lemma saying that its underlying element is omegaE. Each proof therefore unfolds the definition by name and adds Units.val_mkOfMulEqOne to get ((cubicThetaOmegaUnit^k : Eisensteinˣ) : Eisenstein) = omegaE^k. The same simp only [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, cubicThetaOmegaUnit, Units.val_mkOfMulEqOne] list is copied into at least five other places: CubicThetaRamifiedTopPhase.lean line 46, CubicThetaRamifiedResidueFormula.lean lines 37, 56 and 61, CubicThetaRamifiedPhaseRows.lean line 21, and CubicThetaUnitPhaseSymbol.lean lines 54, 58, 67, 68 and 74. Plain `simp` calls, such as `simp [cubicThetaOmegaUnit,...]`, unfold the definition for the same reason. A plain `simp` on a goal containing ↑cubicThetaOmegaUnit^k gets no canonical rewrite to omegaE^k without unfolding the definition.
findings.proposed_change: Where cubicThetaOmegaUnit is defined (CubicThetaRamifiedMiddleSupport.lean), add `@[simp] lemma cubicThetaOmegaUnit_val : ((cubicThetaOmegaUnit : Eisensteinˣ) : Eisenstein) = omegaE := rfl`. It is `rfl` for the same reason cubicThetaOmegaUnit_inverse_value is. Optionally also add `@[simp] lemma cubicThetaOmegaUnit_pow_val (k : ℕ) : ((cubicThetaOmegaUnit ^ k : Eisensteinˣ) : Eisenstein) = omegaE ^ k`, proved with Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val. Then `hd` becomes `by simp [d]` or `by simp only [d, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, cubicThetaOmegaUnit_val]`, and the other sites can use the same lemma without unfolding the definition. The rewrite runs left to right, from a coercion to a fixed constant, so it cannot loop.
findings.benefit: The repeated definition-unfolding simp list becomes one canonical simp rule, and these proofs no longer depend on how cubicThetaOmegaUnit is built with Units.mkOfMulEqOne. If the definition changes, only one lemma needs fixing. Plain `simp` also normalizes the unit coercion to omegaE^k, which is the form the other lemmas (cubicThetaArithmeticFourierResidue_primary_unit and the hypotheses in cubicThetaRamifiedTop_negative_inverse) use.
